main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of next 3-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; over at least 1000 grid cases

decided_by: Confirm rule met: the slope is positive with t >= 2 over at least 1000 grid cases.
reading: All grid cells (positions 0,3,6,... of each window with a bar 3 ahead) enter the regression, including those with a zero forecast, and the coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over its grid cells of all windows.
